cards.title: Scope is the only difference (decision 106)
items: All three roles — Examiner, Lead/Approver, Auditor — read identical full detail; nothing here returns a redacted or summarized version depending on who's asking

The real distinction is reach: Examiner/Lead-Approver only reach the log from within an examination they're assigned to, while Auditor's read is portfolio-wide and is their effective landing page — they hold no drafting/sign-off role that needs the per-examination workspace otherwise

cards.title: Diagram scope
items: log_checkpoint() is the single write path into audit_log[] for every agent, at every interrupt() resolution and state transition (tool-contracts.md) — no agent writes an AuditLogEntry any other way

Hash-chain integrity checking and retry policy (2s timeout, 3 attempts, never retried on chain_integrity_violation) are the tool contract's job, not repeated in full here; schema/retention policy is ADR-0024, not this diagram
